fidelity.description: Edge-overlay IoU between the render and the source line-art (FR-52). Below min → the job fails and retries; never delivered.
fidelity.source: PRD §3 success metrics: Stage 1 render geometry fidelity ≥ 0.85.

colour.description: Mean colour of the rendered region vs the material's colour value (FR-164). Above the threshold the material is labelled colour approximate — a flag, not a failure.
colour.source: PRD FR-164: initial threshold set from the eval harness. Null until the eval report lands; until then every colour-coded material is labelled colour approximate.

generative_video.source: PRD FR-127, FR-130: preview clips carry no fidelity score and are capped at 10 seconds.

metering.description: Credits are taken once, when a render is delivered. A fidelity or moderation retry never consumes credits, and a job that fails after its attempts charges nothing.
metering.source: Contract review, 27 Sept 2026 (Tokunbo); PRD FR-52, FR-56, FR-131.
